correctness.rationale: Exact centered-rank description of every acyclic orientation; the global hub score creates quadratic pair interactions. Multinomial count is exhaustive and integer-valued; centered independent rank variables give the exact variance; fixed-k CLT and strong law give the non-Gaussian chi-square limit. An independently built direct edge-sign enumeration checked 548748 distinct vertices in seven configurations, with all shell frequencies, rational moments and outer-contact counts matching.

value.rationale: Determines the exact full Euclidean vertex-radius shell multiset for an infinite family of natural graphical zonotopes, not just an extreme radius; sharp quadratic variance growth and a non-Gaussian scaled chi-square limit exhibit genuine failure of shell concentration under uniform vertex sampling, despite fixed-size permutahedral petals. The all-shell invariant and asymptotic law are geometrically motivated and not implied by prior extremal or uniform-volume results.
